name: self.mp3
description: A private music library you actually own. Import, tag, sync to your phone, listen offline.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/replica && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/desktop-bridge && npm run web --workspace @selfmp3/app -- --port 4601
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/replica && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/desktop-bridge && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/server && npm run export:web --workspace @selfmp3/app
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/replica && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/desktop-bridge && npm run export:web --workspace @selfmp3/app && npm run dist --workspace @selfmp3/desktop
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/shared && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/replica && npm run build --workspace @selfmp3/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @selfmp3/app
scripts.check:app: npm run typecheck:app && npm run lint:app && npm run test:app
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:app
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
